description: This file defines the Jsonifiable interface in Java, which specifies how entities can be represented as JSON. It includes nested interfaces for generating JSON with predicates, pointers, field selectors, and combinations thereof, along with default method implementations and versioning support.

methods.name: getLatestSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the highest supported JsonSchemaVersion, or throws an exception if none are supported.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns all supported JsonSchemaVersions; defaults to V_1 and V_2.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the current JsonSchemaVersion this instance implements; defaults to latest.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if the given version (int or JsonSchemaVersion) is supported by this Jsonifiable.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to its JsonValue representation.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the object via toJson().
